genericProblem: A successor package-exit validator can treat pre-baseline historical prompt intakes as if they were created by the successor, so an unrelated historical intake without a disposition blocks the successor exit.
searchQueries: problem-intakes and problem-family-dispositions against RM1-U02 baseline entries

counterexamples.claim: Every intake outside the RM1-U02 baseline was created by the RM1-U02 successor and must have a successor disposition.
counterexamples.evidence: The RM1-U02 baseline has zero intake entries while the working tree has 99 post-baseline intake files; historical intake 363f52a2... exists without a disposition and predates this P3-A discovery work.

counterexamples.claim: Validating only current-problem-intake is sufficient for package exit.
counterexamples.evidence: The package-exit path scans the intake directory and reaches historical 363f52a2... even though current-problem-intake is the separately declared authority.

findings.summary: RM1-U02 package-exit validation has a finite baseline-scope gap: the empty intake baseline and global intake scan allow historical 363f52a2... to be attributed to the successor.

The generic failure is distinct from any individual historical intake content; the required scope is baseline intake snapshot, current intake, and post-baseline intake set rather than a one-file exception.
This P3-A discovery is evidence-only by authorization; it must not alter the compliance-control validator or package-exit artifact in this action.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: P3-A evidence-only authorization; no validator or package-exit changes in this action
